_purpose: Records whose filing shows the adopted prior-year development figure to be a take-on: the reserves a loss portfolio transfer brought in, or an RITC premium. A take-on is not development. run_analysis.py (load_and_classify) tags such a record TAKEON_NOT_DEVELOPMENT when it would otherwise be reliable: the record stays in the corpus and is not modelled, the way a net-basis record is recorded and excluded, and the disposition ledger counts it in a step of its own. A syndicate-year in the RITC regime whose adopted figure is development stays in the sample. takeon_amount_m is the transferred amount the filing states, in millions of the report's own currency; where no filing states it, the readings' inference, marked so in takeon_amount_basis. The loader refuses an entry without two readings, its pages and a quote; an entry marked _to_complete is skipped, not applied, until it carries them. A triangle figure whose latest step the filing shows to be dominated by a take-on is a take-on in the same sense (1274/2018: the Motor RITC accepted on 1 January 2018), and so is the premium of a loss portfolio transfer adopted as development (1980/2018). A figure the filing shows to be dominated by the commutation of such a transfer back to its cedant is not development either (1856/2020, the mirror of 1856/2018's take-on; R221, the frozen review's M02: the same rule for analogous quota-share transfers); its takeon_amount_m is the amount the filing prints for the transfer out, with a negative sign. An entry with figure_route 'mature_cohort_triangle' describes the step of the record's mature-cohort figure (data/mature_cohort_figures.json): the loader applies it only under the primary outcome, and refuses it for a block that does not carry that figure.
